data.name: Heiskell
data.long_meaning: The name Heiskell is derived from the Hebrew and Greek words, 'hesed' (loving-kindness, mercy, steadfastness) and 'kellos' (rock, foundation). This name signifies that God is the foundation and source of one's loving-kindness, mercy, and steadfastness.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the steadfast love and faithfulness of God.
data.numerology_meaning: Persons with the name Heiskell are natural born leaders, and are often looked upon as being wise and strong. They have a strong will and a strong personality, and are determined and tenacious.
